summary: Iteration 4: tested chat attachments (A1-A4) and the 5 tools (B1-B5) on the backend and the UI. Backend: the new pytest file tests/test_iter4_attach_tools.py passes 13 of 14 tests. It covers upload of pdf/zip/html, the 10 MB limit, read_file for PDFs and the long-line budget, move_or_copy_file, clean_external_links (byte-identical check on 153 KB), extract_zip, search_in_files, the empty-response error, the length warning, the attachments note, env GET/PUT, and restore before/after. The one failure is minor: PATCH /projects/{pid} leaks env_enc. The regression tests pass: test_donas_api.py 22 passed and 1 skipped, and test_unknown_tool.py gives 'model calls: 2'. UI: tested the env dialog and env injection into the preview, the preview error banner, 'Corrigir com IA' (real call), the restore 409 during a run, the Desfazer confirm, the Versões undo and restore buttons, Inspect, the Desktop/Celular toggle, and the chat attachments end to end (clip, chips, remove, drag-and-drop, paste over 6000 chars, real call that used move_or_copy_file and clean_external_links). I found and fixed one Inspect bug. One small UX bug is left: Esc does not cancel Inspect unless focus is inside the iframe.

minor.issue: The response is the raw get_project() document, so it includes env_enc (the encrypted ciphertext). GET /projects and GET /projects/{pid} strip it. Fix: pop env_enc in patch_project (or in a shared serializer).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. The inspect script is a JS template literal, so '\s' turned into 's' in the generated regexes. Effects: the picked element text had every letter 's' replaced by a space ('Cliques: 0' became 'Clique : 0'), the tag snippet kept data-donas-src, and className split on 's'. Changed to '\\s' in lines 65-77 and checked in the UI: the text is 'Cliques: 0' and the tag is '<button>'.

Esc only cancels Inspect if the keydown happens inside the iframe. After clicking preview-inspect-btn, focus stays in the parent page, so pressing Esc does nothing and preview-inspect-hint stays visible. Fix: add a window keydown listener in PreviewPanel while inspect is on that calls setInspect(false).

action_items: Strip env_enc from the PATCH /api/projects/{pid} response.
Make Esc cancel Inspect when focus is in the parent page (window keydown listener in PreviewPanel).

Optional: removing an attachment chip leaves the uploaded file in uploads/ (orphan), and re-attaching a file with the same name silently overwrites uploads/<name>. Consider a unique suffix or a warning.
critical_code_review_comments: In the real run the model copied page.html instead of moving it, although the prompt said 'Mova' (move_or_copy_file defaults to mode=copy). This is model behaviour, not a code bug. The system prompt could say to pass mode='move' when the user asks to move.
server.py is 740 lines (over the 700-line guideline); consider moving the env, versions and upload routes into routers.
Templates in preview.js: any future regex inside the inspectScript/errorScript template literals must escape backslashes twice.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work after the tester fix; Esc-from-parent bug left)

seed_data_creation: Created the scratch projects TEST_iter4_tools (pytest fixture, auto-deleted), TEST_iter4_err and TEST_iter4_env (deleted at the end via iter4_setup_scratch.py delete). Project 90476221 was not changed (only read for Inspect). Used 2 real OpenRouter calls: the attachment move/clean run and Corrigir com IA, about US$0.002 in total.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest tests/test_iter4_attach_tools.py -n 0` (it needs serial mode because tests share module state). To create projects for UI tests, use `python tests/iter4_setup_scratch.py`; it prints the ids and `delete <ids>` cleans them up. Workspace route is /p/:id. In Playwright, use an async def dialog handler with `import asyncio` for the confirm dialogs. To test Esc inside the iframe, dispatch the KeyboardEvent in the frame document. Verified in the UI: env injection (Titulo: TEST_valor_env), the error banner, dismiss and reopen via the counter, the 409 on restore while the AI runs, undo-message-N with confirm reverting App.js, restore-version-N (mode=after), and message.attachments persisted with summary.
rca of the issue: Inspect text corruption: inspectScript is defined with backticks, so in '/\s+/g' the '\s' is an unknown escape and evaluates to 's'. The iframe got '/s+/g', which replaced every 's' in the element text. Fix: write '\\s' inside the template literal.
